notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing any other creature.
Dictate of Erebos triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Overseer of the Damned triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token for each creature sacrificed.
Resolve the Woe Strider trigger, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop any time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent control.
